responsibility: This file provides the minimal language-driver hooks required for the jit frontend to coexist with GCC’s driver framework. Its lang_specific_driver, lang_specific_pre_link, and lang_specific_extra_outfiles definitions are effectively no-ops, reflecting that libgccjit is not driven through normal source-file command-line compilation. Its responsibility is satisfying GCC driver integration points for the dummy jit language rather than performing any real option processing.
